title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: So, tomorrow, for example, you guys will call two guys up (one being the 26th man). Will both of them be "recalled" from Toledo, regardless of who is the 26th man? Technically-speaking
And do you guys have to designate the 26th man? Or hypothetically, could they both pitch, and you guys just send one down after the game
You have to designate the /26th man
And is eligible for both games
And even so, he is still "recalled"
Yeah that's fine way to put it
If a player is designated as 26th man, I would have to imagine he doesn't burn an option, right?
Like if the guy came up once as the 26th man, does he lose an option year for that?
No. You use an option if you are in the minors on option for more than 20 days
Ok..So you could get optioned twice, stay down for exactly 10 days each time, and keep an option year?
My first text wasn't clear sorry
